name: Ajmer
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Rajasthan’s official Citizen UDH Urban GIS portal exposes Khasra, Plot and urban-jurisdiction map layers and states that Khasra/village boundaries come from the Settlement Department. The official state annual report says citizens can view Khasra boundaries and RoR information for urban properties. The application shell does not establish a full-vector response schema or whether the WUP point is covered by a parcel layer.
scopeLimits: Bounded official-source and public-service review. No citywide completeness is claimed. No owner, address, account, tax, personal-property or credential fields are retained.
technicalBlocker: Viewer/service schema could not be inspected; local shell request timed out, which does not establish provider failure. No exact-point lookup or full polygon response was obtained.
remainingUncertainty: Whether Citizen UDH returns full parcel polygons and whether data at Ajmer WUP point are city cadastral parcels rather than generalized Khasra/plot display remain unresolved.
nextStep: Parent review may decide whether additional viewer/source investigation is useful; no geometry/runtime claim is made.
